metadata.name: backstop_offers
metadata.description: BACKSTOP offer book: escrowed sell offers, randomised pro-rata settlement, Shield priority, AMM remainder routing and Return Tickets.

accounts.name: refund_authority
docs: Required for chest-funded bids: the chest-market PDA (so the chest
program can credit the refund to the bidder's chest atomically).

accounts.name: seller_holder
docs: Seller's holder (tenure carried by the offer + self-fill ring).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Market governance (root markets) or the launchpad PDA (children).

accounts.name: funder
docs: The bidder (wallet bids) or the chest-market PDA (chest/auto bids).

accounts.name: shield_authority
docs: Shield PDA of the chest program: settlement is always routed through
the chest program so the Shield's priority slice is booked atomically

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the Return Ticket (keeper / cranker).

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Caller is not authorised

errors.name: OffersPaused
errors.msg: New offers are paused (emergency)

errors.name: BelowMinimumOffer
errors.msg: Offer is below the minimum offer size; sell directly on the AMM

errors.name: HolderRequired
errors.msg: Seller must have a registered holder account

errors.name: MessageTooLong
errors.msg: Offer message exceeds 140 bytes

errors.name: NotOpen
errors.msg: Offer is not open for bids

errors.name: WindowEnded
errors.msg: Bidding window has ended

errors.name: SelfBid
errors.msg: Sellers cannot bid on their own offers

errors.name: LinkedWallet
errors.msg: Bidder funded the seller within the self-fill window

errors.name: BidTooSmall
errors.msg: Bid is smaller than one lot

errors.name: CannotCloseYet
errors.msg: Bidding cannot be closed yet

errors.name: NotClosing
errors.msg: Offer is not ready to settle

errors.name: RandomnessPending
errors.msg: Randomness slot not reached yet

errors.name: RandomnessUnavailable
errors.msg: Randomness unavailable for the committed slot (re-arm with close_bidding)

errors.name: ShieldSliceTooLarge
errors.msg: Shield slice exceeds the maximum share

errors.name: NotSettled
errors.msg: Offer is not settled

errors.name: NoRemainder
errors.msg: Remainder already sold or nothing to sell

errors.name: OfferNotFinished
errors.msg: Offer still has unclaimed bids or unsold remainder

errors.name: AccountMismatch
errors.msg: Account does not match the offer

errors.name: TicketUnavailable
errors.msg: Return Ticket expired or exhausted

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic error

fields.name: bidder
docs: Wallet that receives the tokens (and tenure credit).

fields.name: refund_to
docs: Account the refund is returned to (bidder's quote ATA or chest vault).

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Receives the bid account's rent on claim.

fields.name: amount
docs: Quote locked (= capacity × lot_cost).

fields.name: prefix
docs: Σ capacities of earlier bids (`Q_i`).

types.name: FeeStats
docs: Lifetime fee accounting (invariant: collected == Σ components).

types.name: Holder
docs: Per-wallet tenure, weight and reward checkpoint.

types.name: HookConfig
docs: Market-level hook configuration (Borsh account, rarely written).

fields.name: reward_ready
docs: RewardState has reached its full size and is initialised.

fields.name: governance
docs: Governance (Squads multisig vault on mainnet).

fields.name: pending_governance
docs: Two-step governance transfer target (default = none).

fields.name: core_authority
docs: `backstop-core` market PDA: may deposit rewards and record burns.

fields.name: offers_authority
docs: `backstop-offers` book PDA: may credit absorb tenure.

fields.name: chest_authority
docs: `backstop-chest` chest-market PDA: may harvest rewards into chests.

fields.name: amm_authority
docs: `backstop-amm` pool PDA: transfers into it from wallets are direct sells.

fields.name: allowed_programs
docs: Programs that may be the top-level instruction of a token movement.

fields.name: allowed_owners
docs: Off-curve token-account owners permitted to receive tokens.

fields.name: tenure_cap_secs
docs: Average age at which the tenure multiplier caps (default 90 d).

fields.name: tenure_extra_bps
docs: Multiplier above 1.0 at the cap, bps (default 20_000 → 3.0×).

fields.name: absorb_tenure_bps
docs: Share of a seller's lot tenure transferred to absorbers (default 40 %).

fields.name: direct_sell_cap
docs: Rolling per-wallet cap on direct AMM sells (default = min offer size).

fields.name: link_min_amount
docs: Minimum direct transfer recorded in the recent-sender ring.

fields.name: epoch_secs
docs: Distribution epoch length — immutable after initialisation.

fields.name: genesis_ts
docs: Boundary 0 timestamp — immutable after initialisation.

fields.name: parent
docs: Parent market for launchpad children (default for BACKSTOP itself).

fields.name: guardian
docs: May only *set* pause flags (immediate emergency stop).

fields.name: keeper
docs: Executes fee swaps (bounded by the oracle and slippage cap).

fields.name: swap_program
docs: Swap program allowed for fee conversion (Jupiter v6 on mainnet).

fields.name: redemption_paused
docs: Redemption can only be paused through the 48 h timelock.

fields.name: fee_vault
docs: Quote ATA of this market PDA receiving all trade fees.

fields.name: treasury_quote_vault
docs: Quote ATA of the treasury PDA (treasury share awaiting conversion).

fields.name: holder_rewards_vault
docs: Chest program vault receiving holder rewards.

fields.name: shield_rewards_vault
docs: Chest program vault receiving Shield rewards.

fields.name: parent_vault
docs: Quote ATA of this market PDA holding the parent's share (children).

fields.name: amm_base_vault
docs: AMM base vault (protocol-held supply excluded from circulation).

fields.name: treasury_sol_in
docs: Lamports received from fee conversion.

fields.name: shield_lamports_pending
docs: Redemption fees (lamports) awaiting conversion to Shield rewards.

types.name: MarketParams
docs: Every governable parameter of a market (spec §3). Defaults in
[`MarketParams::defaults`].

fields.name: parent_share_bps
docs: Share of gross fees routed to the parent market (children only).

fields.name: shield_max_premium_bps
docs: Shield skips offers whose short TWAP exceeds the hourly TWAP by more
than this (pump-and-dump protection).

fields.name: direct_sell_hourly_cap
docs: Global cap on direct (sub-minimum) AMM sells per hour, base units.

fields.name: max_swap_slippage_bps
docs: Max slippage vs. oracle on keeper fee swaps (spec: 0.5 %).

fields.name: max_swap_chunk
docs: Max single keeper swap; larger amounts are TWAP-chunked by the keeper.

fields.name: seller_quote
docs: Seller's quote account receiving fill and remainder proceeds.

fields.name: bid_vault
docs: ATA(offer, quote) holding bid funds.

fields.name: amount
docs: Tokens escrowed at creation.

fields.name: twap
docs: TWAP at creation (quote per base × 1e18) and the frozen fill price.

fields.name: seller_lot_tenure
docs: Tenure carried by the escrowed tokens (seller's lot tenure).

fields.name: total_capacity
docs: Σ bid capacities (lots) — `C` in the allocation.

fields.name: random_offset
docs: Systematic-sampling offset `U ∈ [0, C)`.

fields.name: bidder_lots
docs: Lots allocated to bidders: min(C, lots − shield_lots).

fields.name: escrowed
docs: Tokens still in escrow for this offer.

fields.name: escrow_vault
docs: ATA(book, mint): escrow for every offer of this market (D-013).

fields.name: total_escrowed
docs: Σ offer.escrowed — always equals the escrow vault balance.

types.name: OracleConfig
docs: Price source used to bound keeper swaps.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = governance-set manual price (localnet/devnet), 1 = Pyth PriceUpdateV2.

fields.name: feed
docs: Pyth price-update account (kind = 1).

fields.name: manual_quote_per_sol
docs: Manual price: quote base units per 1 SOL (1e9 lamports).

types.name: Pool
docs: Constant-product pool. Liquidity is protocol-owned and cannot be
withdrawn (D-015). Reserves are tracked internally (donations ignored).

fields.name: amount
docs: Tokens that may be re-bought fee-free.
